title: Report actioned
description: A moderator applied an enforcement action to a report. Identity consumes this for the real effect. The subject is the report. Payloads never include content, snapshots or reporter identity.

action_id.description: The moderation action that was applied.

rule_id.description: Rule selected for the statement of reasons.

user_id.description: The account the action affects, when known.

restrictions.description: Named restrictions added when action is restrict.

expires_at.description: When a lock or restriction ends. Null or omitted for permanent actions.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason, such as icu_h1 for proscribed organisation removal.
